media_strategy.selection_principle: All five channels are used and every asset is REAL media: 13 verified license-clean photos (Scout + Detective), 3 oEmbed-verified official YouTube embeds, 1 CC0 recording. Zero generative calls were made — every concrete subject in this story (players, coach, stadium, islands, streets, the singer, the ship) has a verified real photo, so AI atmosphere would only dilute the reported texture (real-media policy: prefer fetched reals; never generate a real subject).
media_strategy.layer_rule: BINDING (ana_caveat_01): every diaspora chart/metric carries its layer label. All ana_01..ana_05 visuals are labelled 'UN born-in-Cabo-Verde floor'; census (CBS 23,150) and heritage (~500k / ~120%) numbers live only in attributed prose, never in the same chart.
media_strategy.reveal_protection: BINDING (PIT-57): no rendered des_ string states 15/26, 57.7%, zero home-based, 27.9-per-100 or 5.1x ahead of its widget. des_09 (57.7/50.3 chart) is pinned BELOW the edt_03 hero widget and its payoff paragraphs; des_13 (27.9 in the ana_05 ranking) is pinned to the END of edt_06 after the guess widget; des_22 avoids any 5.1x annotation.

page_rhythm.tone: dark cinematic editorial — deep-Atlantic navy field, warm sand-white ink, star-gold accent; sober longing (sodade) under a sports epic, never neon-sport

theme.derived_from: editorial_dark (themes.json), tuned to this story's Atlantic/deep-blue + island-warm system
theme.accent_rationale: --accent #F2B544 is the star-gold of the ten stars on Cape Verde's flag, warmed for a dark field: it marks the Cape Verde / diaspora datum in EVERY chart (consistency rule — one value, one color). --accent-2 #4E8FD9 is the Atlantic blue of the flag's field, used for comparisons, the island-born squad segment and the map's sequential ocean ramp. Gold-vs-blue is a CVD-safe orange/blue pair; meaning is never carried by color alone (direct labels + markers everywhere).

page_rhythm.type_pairing: didone_fashion (typography.json tier-1): display Didot / 'Bodoni MT' / 'Noto Serif Display' serif at h1-h2 only; body Georgia / 'Times New Roman' serif; UI system-ui. Weight/size extremes: hairline didone masthead over heavy Georgia stat numbers, h1 at 3x+ body scale.
page_rhythm.data_color_notes: Charts on dark surfaces: guide text/axis labels in --ink/--muted LIGHT values (never near-black — dark-mode-safe guide text is a hard gate); hairline gridlines in --line; sequential map ramp = deep navy -> #4E8FD9 -> pale sand, shared between the edt_05 scrolly map and any density encodings; the amber accent is reserved for Cape Verde/focal datums only.
page_rhythm.text_visual_pattern: hero -> masthead + vinyl BGM card -> reported hook (photo + embed + one big stat) -> alternating [prose -> playground -> payoff prose -> chart] per section; photos punctuate the turns (edt_03 diptych, edt_07 history run, edt_10 full-circle). Charts never streak: every chart is separated by prose, a photo or a playground.
page_rhythm.centrepiece: the edt_03 strip-the-diaspora hero playground (Interaction Engineer, cm_02) — this file's visual system stages it: flag chips from the PD flag set, gold=diaspora/blue=island-born encoding matching des_09, and the des_07/des_08 diptych priming it
page_rhythm.anti_sameness_notes: Not the WC-blog keynote look and not a generic dark dashboard: didone masthead (not grotesk), a two-hue flag-derived data system (not a rainbow), an emotional midpoint where the audio embed IS the argument (the Sodade scrolly), and a photo-led close (the reserved Rotterdam street) instead of a summary chart. The one deliberate echo of previous blogs is the canonical vinyl BGM card, which is fixed by doctrine.
page_rhythm.typography_notes: Drop cap on the article's first paragraph only (accent gold). Kicker eyebrows (uppercase, letter-spaced, accent) above section titles — the Copywriter's kicker 'World Cup 2026 · The diaspora' sits above the masthead. ONE divider style: the asterism (finish.json divider-ast) between sections. Dateline byline under the standfirst. One pull-quote treatment (oversized_serif, gold left rule) reserved for Maria da Cruz's 'chasing every ball' quote in edt_03. Stat callouts in display serif at 64-72px with count-up (static under prefers-reduced-motion). No paper grain (dark cinematic field stays clean).
page_rhythm.motion_notes: Content visible by default (reveal-visible-by-default); scroll-driven scrollies are linear with the scrub (no easing fights); count-up on the two stat callouts and the live badge; vinyl disc spins only while audio plays; hero cinemagraph loops seamlessly with poster fallback; cinematic scroll backgrounds cross-fade at section boundaries (Cinematographer); no hover-scale spam, no blur entrances; all motion gated by prefers-reduced-motion.
